T: One dairyman, five daughters, and enough blintzes to go round.
D: In a small Jewish village in Tsarist Russia in 1905, a poor dairyman tries to hold on to the old ways as his three eldest daughters choose their own husbands.
P: Serve the challah when Golde lights the candles for the Friday night dinner.
S: the candles lit on the Friday night table as the sun goes down

Soft plaited egg bread sweetened with honey, glazed golden and scattered with sesame seeds. Stir 7g dried yeast and 3 tbsp honey into 200ml warm water and leave for 5 minutes until foamy. Add 500g bread flour, 1 1/2 tsp salt, 2 eggs and 60ml vegetable oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove for 1 1/2 hours until doubled. Divide into 3, roll into 40cm ropes and plait, tucking the ends under. Prove on a lined tray for 45 minutes. Brush with egg yolk, scatter with 1 tbsp sesame seeds and bake at 190C for 30 minutes until deep golden. Cool for 15 minutes before tearing.
Yente at the door with news about every family in the village

Pickled herring chopped by hand with egg, apple and red onion, spread thick on dark rye with dill. Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. On a board, finely chop 300g drained pickled herring fillets, the eggs, 1 peeled green apple and half a small red onion. Mix with 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp caster sugar and plenty of black pepper, then cover and chill for 30 minutes. Spread thickly on 8 slices of dark rye and scatter with chopped dill.
M: Tevye's milk cart doing the rounds while the horse limps along

Thin pancakes rolled around sweet lemon and vanilla cheese, fried golden in butter, with sour cream and warm cherries. Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs, 375ml milk, a pinch of salt and 30g melted butter to a thin batter and rest for 30 minutes. Beat 400g ricotta, 150g soft cream cheese, 1 egg yolk, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Simmer 400g frozen pitted cherries with 3 tbsp sugar and the lemon juice for 5 minutes, then thicken with 2 tsp cornflour mixed with a little water. Cook 12 thin pancakes in a lightly buttered 20cm pan, on one side only. Put a spoonful of filling on the cooked side of each, fold in the sides and roll into parcels. Fry in 40g butter, seam side down first, until golden on both sides. Serve 3 each with sour cream and the warm cherries.
W: the midnight story Tevye spins for Golde about her grandmother

Dark, moist honey cake spiced with cinnamon, clove, ginger and orange, topped with toasted almonds. Heat the oven to 170C and line a 23cm square tin. Whisk 3 eggs with 150g brown sugar until thick, then whisk in 250g honey, 125ml vegetable oil and 180ml cooled strong black tea. Whisk in 300g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp each ground cloves and ginger and the zest of 1 orange. Pour into the tin, scatter with 50g flaked almonds and bake for 50 minutes until dark and springy. Cool in the tin for 30 minutes before cutting into squares.
K: Samovar glass tea with lemon and cherry jam
the whole family round Tevye's table with the samovar always on

Strong black tea poured into glasses with a slice of lemon, cherry jam and sugar cubes on the side. Brew 2 tbsp strong loose leaf black tea in a small pot with 250ml boiling water for 5 minutes. Pour a little of the concentrate into 4 heatproof glasses and top up with 750ml boiling water to the strength you like. Serve each with a thin lemon slice, a spoonful of cherry jam to stir in or eat alongside, and 2 sugar cubes.

note.text: Tevye, the cheese is ready for market, the horse has lost a shoe again and Yente comes at four. Wash your hands and sit before I light the candles.

prop.title: Friday Night Table
lines: Challah, honey cake and glass tea

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep wrapped; the dough can do its first prove overnight in the fridge

steps.text: Stir the yeast and honey into the warm water and leave until foamy.
Add the flour, salt, eggs and oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and springy.
Cover and prove until doubled.
Divide into 3, roll each into a 40cm rope and plait them, tucking the ends under.
Set on a lined tray, cover loosely and prove until puffy. Heat the oven to 190C.
Brush with the egg yolk, scatter with sesame seeds and bake until deep golden and hollow when tapped underneath.
Cool on a rack before tearing.

dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead and keep covered in the fridge

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Chop the herring, eggs, apple and onion finely by hand on a board.
Mix with the vinegar, sugar and plenty of black pepper.
Cover and chill so the flavours settle.
Spread thickly on the rye bread and scatter with dill.

veg.n: Yente's chopped egg and onion on rye
veg.make_ahead: Make up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Meanwhile fry the onion slowly in the oil until deep golden, then cool.
Chop the eggs and apple finely by hand and mix with the onion, its oil and the pickle. Season well with salt and pepper.
Cover and chill so the flavours settle.
Spread thickly on the rye bread and scatter with dill.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the pancakes and mix the filling up to 1 day ahead, keep separately in the fridge; make the cherries up to 3 days ahead; fill and fry to serve

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, salt and melted butter to a smooth thin batter and rest it.
Beat the ricotta, cream cheese, egg yolk, filling sugar, vanilla and lemon zest until smooth.
Simmer the cherries with their sugar and the lemon juice until juicy, then stir in the cornflour mixed with a splash of water and bubble until glossy.
Cook 12 thin pancakes in a lightly buttered 20cm frying pan, on one side only, and stack them cooked side up.
Put a heaped spoonful of filling on each, fold in the sides and roll into a parcel.
Fry the parcels in the frying butter, seam side down first, until golden on both sides.
Serve 3 each with sour cream and the warm cherries.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 4 days ahead; it gets stickier and better wrapped at room temperature

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 23cm square cake tin.
Whisk the eggs and brown sugar until thick, then whisk in the honey, oil and tea.
Whisk in the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, spices and orange zest to a smooth, runny batter.
Pour into the tin, scatter with the almonds and bake until dark and springy and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin before cutting into squares.

dishes.n: Samovar glass tea with lemon and cherry jam
dishes.make_ahead: Slice the lemon up to 4 hours ahead; brew the tea fresh

steps.text: Brew the tea in a small pot with 250ml of the boiling water for 5 minutes to make a strong concentrate.
Pour a little concentrate into 4 heatproof glasses and top up with the rest of the boiling water to taste.
Serve each glass with a lemon slice, a spoonful of cherry jam and sugar cubes on the side.
